entities.name: it is wrong to allege that the OPs are vested with the unilateral right to extend or cancel the RCA
Commission frowns upon unilateral termination clauses introduced by entities which have market power and which reduces the bargaining power of the parties contracting with the dominant entity
Commission cannot substitute its wisdom to that of the procurer in respect of the terms of procurements, the periodicity thereof and terms of RCAS etc.

Commission leaves it to the OPs to make suitable adjustments in the clauses bearing in mind the niceties of policy so as to dispel the notion of ‘take it or leave it’ approach as the manufacturers/suppliers rely solely on the OPs for supply of their products in the State of Andhra Pradesh
Commission notes from the submission of the OPs that there has been no instance wherein the aforementioned clause has been exercised by the OPs

entities.name: solely responsible for determining demand and placing orders, when stock so procured is not sold and becomes ‘inactive’, the liability for the same cannot be solely attributable to the manufacturer/supplier of Branded Alcoholic Beverages.
OPs also halt supply of stock to retail outlets.
OPs have unilateral right to rescind OFS.
OFS have never been cancelled so far.
OPs’ actions can be said to be based on an objective criterion and are not downright arbitrary.
Commission does not have any misgivings in relation to the clauses pertaining to slow-moving stock.
OPs ought to exercise the clause uniformly in a non-discriminatory manner and with abundant care and caution.
Commission ordinarily would not like to interfere in such situations.
